title: Club Rules for Members' Guests, Resort Club Memberships
content:
Rule 1. At the start of each membership year of a Resort Club Memberships membership, the level's number of guest passes is allocated. Unused passes lapse at the end of the year where the level's passes do not carry over, and on termination.

Rule 2. A guest is admitted only with the member present where the level requires the member to accompany the guest, only to a facility among the level's guest facilities, and at most the level's number of guests per visit.

Rule 3. Each guest uses one pass per visit day while passes remain; once none remain, each guest visit is charged the level's guest fee.

Rule 4. Guests are admitted only while the membership's status is active.

Rule 5. A guest uses one pass or one guest fee per visit day, never both.

## How the rules show on the club account

| Event | Entry on the account |
|---|---|
| Start of a membership year (the first one begins on the start date) | Guest pass allocation of the year's passes |
| Guest admitted on a pass | One guest pass used, recorded with the guest's name, the visit date and the facility |
| Guest admitted once no passes remain | One guest fee, recorded with the guest's name, the visit date and the facility |
| End of the membership year, or termination, with passes left | Guest pass lapse of the passes left |

## Conditions of admission

A guest is admitted only when every one of the following holds:

- the membership's status is active;
- the member is present with the guest, where the level requires it;
- the facility is one of the level's guest facilities;
- the guests on the visit number no more than the level's limit per visit.

A membership whose status is pending, frozen, notice given or terminated admits no guests.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- **One pass left, two guests.** A member of an active membership with one pass remaining accompanies two guests on the same day to a facility within the level's guest facilities, at a level allowing two guests per visit. One guest uses the last pass and the other is charged the guest fee.
- **The same guest twice on one day.** A guest already admitted on a pass that visit day uses no second pass and is charged no guest fee for that day.
- **Year end.** Passes still unused when the membership year ends lapse where the level does not carry passes over; the new year's allocation starts afresh.
